pages.text: Soulspring Lamp normalizes the temperature around you when you hold it in your hand. Without it, you simply won't be able to walk on the Nether.

pages.title: Soulspring Lamp
pages.text: You're lucky - Soulspring Lamp is fully fueled when you create it. It is fueled by the sprouts of souls that grow in the Valleys of the Sand of Souls.
The sprouts of souls can also be grown in the Overworld.
pages.title: Sprouts of souls

pages.text: They get on the Soul Sand/Soul Soil. Wait until it is fully ripe, otherwise only 1 unit will fall out.
